unit_cn: Unit 1 Learning for Life 终身学习
source: 上外版选择性必修第一册 Unit 1 词表(真词,△超纲/专名跳过);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、学习/教育/终身学习主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: Her father was an excellent educator who loved poetry.
words.example_cn: 她的父亲是一位热爱诗歌的优秀教育家。

words.example_en: As a child, she was often asked to recite poems in front of visitors.
words.example_cn: 小时候,她常被要求在客人面前背诵诗歌。

words.example_en: Achievement consists in never giving up on your learning.
words.example_cn: 成就在于对学习永不放弃。

words.example_en: The more he studied, the clearer his wisdom became.
words.example_cn: 他学得越多,智慧就越清明。

words.example_en: Patience is a virtue that every lifelong learner needs.
words.example_cn: 耐心是每个终身学习者都需要的美德。

words.example_en: Doing the experiments engaged us in the learning process.
words.example_cn: 做实验让我们投入到学习过程之中。

words.example_en: Speaking in front of others was a great trial for the shy girl.
words.example_cn: 在别人面前讲话对这个害羞的女孩是一大考验。

words.example_en: He struggled with reading as a child but taught himself to write.
words.example_cn: 他小时候阅读很吃力,但自学会了写字。

words.example_en: After the war he went abroad to pursue further studies in physics.
words.example_cn: 战后他出国深造,继续研究物理。

words.example_en: He worked hard and won a scholarship to a famous university.
words.example_cn: 他刻苦努力,赢得了一所名校的奖学金。

words.example_en: His research led to a major breakthrough in battery design.
words.example_cn: 他的研究在电池设计上带来了重大突破。

words.example_en: Even at ninety-seven, he still goes to the laboratory every day.
words.example_cn: 即便九十七岁,他每天仍去实验室。

words.example_en: Darwin helped his brother do many experiments in chemistry.
words.example_cn: 达尔文帮哥哥做了许多化学实验。

words.example_en: Under her father's guidance, Curie developed a taste for poetry.
words.example_cn: 在父亲的指导下,居里渐渐爱上了诗歌。

words.example_en: Since childhood he had been under the influence of his learned father.
words.example_cn: 从小他就一直受到博学父亲的影响。

words.example_en: Real knowledge is to know the extent of one's ignorance.
words.example_cn: 真正的知识是知道自己无知的程度。

words.example_en: His grandfather told him to be patient and practise every day.
words.example_cn: 他祖父叫他要有耐心,每天练习。

words.example_en: The gentleman believes that learning should never cease.
words.example_cn: 君子认为学习不应停止。

words.example_en: He examined himself each day; thus his conduct became faultless.
words.example_cn: 他每天反省自己,因此行为没有过错。

words.example_en: Wide study made both his wisdom and his conduct clear.
words.example_cn: 广泛的学习使他的智慧和举止都变得清明。

words.example_en: He learned that everyone has a strong sense of dignity.
words.example_cn: 他懂得每个人都有强烈的尊严感。

words.example_en: As a boy, he learned to defeat his opponents without shaming them.
words.example_cn: 还是个男孩时,他就学会不羞辱对手地战胜他们。

words.example_en: A good learner treats every opponent with respect.
words.example_cn: 好的学习者尊重每一个对手。

words.example_en: The donkey threw him off, which embarrassed him in front of his friends.
words.example_cn: 驴把他摔了下来,让他在朋友面前很尴尬。

words.example_en: To shame another person is to make him suffer a cruel fate.
words.example_cn: 羞辱他人就是让他遭受残忍的命运。

words.example_en: He felt it was cruel and unnecessary to shame a beaten rival.
words.example_cn: 他觉得羞辱落败的对手既残忍又没必要。

words.example_en: In the fields he learned to gather wild honey and fruits.
words.example_cn: 在田野里他学会了采集野蜂蜜和果子。

words.example_en: Unless you pile up tiny streams, you can never make a river.
words.example_cn: 不积小流,无以成江河。

words.example_en: If you persist without stopping, you can carve metal or stone.
words.example_cn: 锲而不舍,金石可镂。

words.example_en: The finest horse cannot travel ten paces in one leap.
words.example_cn: 最好的马也不能一跃十步。

words.example_en: If metal is put to the grindstone, it can be sharpened.
words.example_cn: 金属放到磨石上,就能被磨利。

words.example_en: If wood is pressed against a board, it can be made straight.
words.example_cn: 木头被压在矫直板上,就能弄直。

words.example_en: He gazed into the distance but saw farther by climbing higher.
words.example_cn: 他眺望远方,但爬得更高才看得更远。

words.example_en: If you climb high and wave, people can see you from far away.
words.example_cn: 登高招手,远处的人也能看见你。

words.meaning_cn: 不知怎么地;以某种方式
words.example_en: The fact that they worked on chemistry somehow got known at school.
words.example_cn: 他们研究化学的事不知怎么在学校传开了。

words.meaning_cn: 实际地;几乎;实事求是地
words.example_en: The work showed him practically the meaning of experimental science.
words.example_cn: 这项工作切实地向他展示了实验科学的意义。

words.example_en: He graduated with honours in mathematics at Yale University.
words.example_cn: 他在耶鲁大学以优异成绩获得数学学位。

words.example_en: He raised money to purchase tools for the school laboratory.
words.example_cn: 他筹钱为学校实验室购买工具。

words.example_en: Giving up too early is the biggest threat to learning.
words.example_cn: 过早放弃是学习最大的威胁。

words.example_en: Many students volunteer to teach younger children after class.
words.example_cn: 许多学生自愿在课后教年幼的孩子。

words.example_en: Learning may occur at home, in the laboratory or in nature.
words.example_cn: 学习可能发生在家里、实验室或大自然中。

words.example_en: She was frequently brought forward to recite when visitors came.
words.example_cn: 有客人来时她常被叫上前去背诵。

words.example_en: Gradually she acquired a strong taste for poetry.
words.example_cn: 渐渐地,她对诗歌产生了浓厚的兴趣。

words.example_en: Through the club I acquired practical knowledge about the environment.
words.example_cn: 通过这个社团我获得了关于环境的实用知识。

words.example_en: She willingly learned long passages from great poets by heart.
words.example_cn: 她乐意地把伟大诗人的长篇段落背了下来。

words.example_en: His teacher's tips turned out to be quite effective.
words.example_cn: 他老师的建议结果很有效。

words.example_en: Working in the club, my sense of responsibility has grown.
words.example_cn: 在社团里工作,我的责任心增强了。

words.example_en: Lifelong learning means we keep growing all through our lives.
words.example_cn: 终身学习意味着我们一生都在不断成长。
